caption.value:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.
Use to summon the spirits of five miranda sprouts.
Summoning consumes HP rather than FP.

Spirits of sweet little miranda flowers, carnivorous blossoms that feed upon human flesh. They creep slowly, scattering toxic pollen.
Vulnerable to fire—do take care of the little darlings.

location.value: Can be found behind an illusionary wall in the Caelid Catacombs , Caelid . Proceed through the Catacombs as normal from the site of grace, once you've reached the first open room, there will be a staircase for you to descend on your left, proceed down and immediately turn around to find a little open room under the stairs that you just came down. Attack the staircase wall to the right to reveal the ashes on a corpse. See it on the Elden Ring Map here.
